about: Real ARCY outputs shown on the site. Each was made by ARCY in a recorded session; nothing is retouched beyond cropping (crops remove a model's name, which the site never shows). Shown at the owner's request of 2026-11-24 ('use real ARCY outputs in colour'); `verdict` is the owner's per-file score out of 4 when he gives one (content/GUARD.md rule 4).
